descriere: Sets the cam switching position 2.
Sets the signal source for the position controller enable 1.
Sets the signal source for the position controller enable 2.

Sets the signal source for the "setpoint fixed" signal. BI: p2551 = 1 signal: The end of the positioning operation on the setpoint side is signaled and the positioning and standstill monitoring activated. BI: p2551 = 0 signal: The start of a positioning operation or tracking mode on the setpoint side is signaled and the positioning and standstill monitoring de-activated.

descriere_scurta: LR signal travel to fixed stop active
descriere: Sets the signal source for the signal "travel to fixed stop active". BI: p2552 = 1 signal: The activity associated with travel to fixed stop is signaled and the detection of the fixed stop is started via the maximum following error (p2634).
Sets the signal source for the signal "fixed stop reached". BI: p2553 = 1 signal: When the fixed stop is reached, this is signaled and the fixed stop monitoring window is activated.

Sets the signal source for the signal "traversing command active". BI: p2554 = 1 signal: It is signaled that positioning is active and therefore the positioning monitoring is not activated with the signal "setpoint fixed" (p2551).
Sets the signal source for the reference of the internal length units LU to motor revolution for rotary encoders and to mm for linear encoders.
Sets the signal source to activate the function "STOP cam". BI: p2568 = 1 signal --> The evaluation of the STOP cam minus (BI: p2569) and STOP cam plus (BI: p2570) is active.
Sets the signal source for the STOP cam in the negative direction of travel.
Sets the maximum acceleration for the "basic positioner" function (EPOS).
Sets the maximum deceleration for the "basic positioner" function (EPOS).
Sets the jerk limiting

Sets the signal source to activate the jerk limiting. Activating/de-activating: - using BI: p2575 = 1 signal or 0 signal. - using the command JERK in the traversing block (only for BI: p2575 = 0 signal).
Sets the modulo range for axes with modulo correction.
Sets the signal source to activate modulo correction.

descriere_scurta: EPOS software limit switch minus signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the software limit switch minus.

descriere_scurta: EPOS software limit switch plus signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the software limit switch plus.
Sets the software limit switch in the negative direction of travel.
Sets the software limit switch in the positive direction of travel.
Sets the signal source to activate the "software limit switch".

Sets the amount of play (backlash) for positive or negative play. 0: The backlash compensation is de-activated. > 0: Positive backlash (normal case) When the direction is reversed, the encoder actual value leads the actual value. < 0: Negative backlash When the direction is reversed, the actual value leads the encoder actual value.
Sets the setpoint velocity for jog 1.
Sets the setpoint velocity for jog 2.
Sets the traversing distance for incremental jog 1.
Sets the traversing distance for incremental jog 2.
Sets the signal source for jog 1.
Sets the signal source for jog 2.
Sets the signal source for jogging incremental.
Sets the signal source for the reference of the internal length units LU to motor revolution for rotary encoders and to mm for linear encoders.
Sets the signal source to start the "search for reference" or "flying referencing". BI: p2595 = 0/1 signal Referencing is started. BI: p2595 = 1/0 signal Referencing is interrupted.
Sets the signal source for the "set reference point".
Sets the signal source to select referencing type. 1 signal: Flying referencing 0 signal: Search for reference
Sets the position value for the reference point coordinate. This value is set as the actual axis position after referencing or adjustment.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference reference point offset
descriere: Sets the reference point offset for search for reference.
Sets the inner window for flying referencing. Value = 0: The evaluation of the inner window is de-activated.
Sets the outer window for flying referencing. Value = 0: The evaluation of the outer window is de-activated.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference start direction
descriere: Sets the signal sources for the start direction of the search for reference. 1 signal: Start in the negative direction. 0 signal: Start in the positive direction.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference approach velocity reference cam
descriere: Sets the approach velocity to the reference cam for the search for reference.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference reference cam maximum distance
descriere: Sets the maximum distance after the start of the search for reference when traversing to the reference cam.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference reference cam present
descriere: Sets whether or not a reference cam is present for the search for reference. Value = 1: Reference cam present. Value = 0: No reference cam present.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference approach velocity zero mark
descriere: Sets the approach velocity after detecting the reference cam to search for the zero mark for the search for reference.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference max distance ref cam and zero mark
descriere: Sets the maximum distance after leaving the reference cam when traversing to the zero mark.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for ref. tol. bandwidth for distance to zero mark
descriere: Sets the tolerance bandwidth for the distance to the zero mark The zero mark is evaluated within the maximum distance between the reference cam and zero mark (p2609) minus the tolerance bandwidth for the distance to the zero mark (p2610).

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference approach velocity reference point
descriere: Sets the approach velocity after detecting the zero mark to approach the reference point.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference reference cam
descriere: Sets the signal source for the reference cam.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference reversing cam minus
descriere: Sets the signal source for the reversing cam in the negative direction of travel. 1 signal: Reversing cam not reached. 0 signal: Reversing cam reached.

descriere_scurta: EPOS search for reference reversing cam plus
descriere: Sets the signal source for the reversing cam in the negative direction of travel. 1 signal: Reversing cam not reached. 0 signal: Reversing cam reached.

descriere_scurta: EPOS maximum number of traversing blocks
descriere: Sets the maximum number of traversing blocks that are available.

Sets the traversing blocks for sorting corresponding to their block number. Procedure: Set p2624 = 0 --> 1. Sorting is started and the parameters are automatically reset to zero once the operation has been completed.
Sets the signal source to select the traversing block, bit 0.
Sets the signal source to select the traversing block, bit 1.
Sets the signal source to select the traversing block, bit 2.
Sets the signal source to select the traversing block, bit 3.
Sets the signal source to select the traversing block, bit 4.
Sets the signal source to select the traversing block, bit 5.
Sets the signal source for "activating traversing task". BI: p2631 = 0/1 signal The traversing task, selected using BI: p2625 ... p2630, is started.
Sets the mode to evaluate "external block change".
Sets the signal source for "external block change". BI: p2633 = 0/1 signal
Sets the monitoring window of the actual position after the fixed stop is reached.
Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "fixed stop reached". BI: p2637 = 1 signal Fixed stop is reached. BI: p2637 = 0 signal Fixed stop is not reached.

descriere_scurta: EPOS fixed stop outside the monitoring window
descriere: Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "fixed stop outside the monitoring window". BI: p2638 = 1 signal Fixed stop is located outside the monitoring window. BI: p2638 = 0 signal Fixed stop is inside the monitoring window.
Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "torque limit reached" when traversing to fixed stop. BI: p2639 = 1 signal Torque limit is reached. BI: p2639 = 0 signal Torque limit is not reached.
Sets the signal source for the "no intermediate stop/intermediate stop". BI: p2640 = 1 signal No intermediate stop. BI: p2640 = 0 signal Intermediate stop.
Sets the signal source for "do not reject traversing task/reject traversing task". BI: p2641 = 1 signal Do not reject traversing task. BI: p2641 = 0 signal Reject traversing task.

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI position setpoint
descriere: Sets the signal source for the position setpoint in the mode "direct setpoint input/MDI".

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI velocity setpoint
descriere: Sets the signal source for the velocity setpoint in the "direct setpoint input/MDI mode".

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI acceleration override
descriere: Sets the signal source for the acceleration override in the operating mode "direct setpoint input/MDI".

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI deceleration override
descriere: Sets the signal source for the deceleration override in the operating mode "direct setpoint input/MDI".

Sets the signal source for the velocity override. This velocity override is effective in the following operating modes "direct setpoint input/MDI", "traversing blocks", "jogging" and "search for reference" (when approaching the reference cam).
Sets the signal source for selecting the operating mode "direct setpoint input/MDI".

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI positioning type
descriere: Sets the signal source for the positioning type in the mode "direct setpoint input/MDI". BI: p2648 = 1 signal Absolute positioning is selected. BI: p2648 = 0 signal Relative positioning is selected.

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI transfer type selection
descriere: Sets the signal source to define how values are transferred in the operating mode "direct setpoint input/MDI". BI: p2649 = 1 signal Values are continually transferred (refer to parameter under dependency). BI: p2649 = 0 signal The values are transferred for BI: p2650 = 0/1 signal.

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI setpoint acceptance edge
descriere: Sets the signal source to accept the values for edge-triggered selection (BI: p2649 = 0 signal) in the operating mode "direct setpoint input/MDI". BI: p2650 = 0/1 signal and BI: p2649 = 0 signal Values are accepted, edge-triggered (refer to parameter under dependency).

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI direction selection, positive
descriere: Sets the signal source for the positive direction selection in the operating mode "direct setpoint input/MDI".

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI direction selection negative
descriere: Sets the signal source for the negative direction selection in the operating mode "direct setpoint input/MDI".

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI setting-up selection
descriere: Sets the signal source for setting-up in the operating mode "direct setpoint input/MDI". BI: p2653 = 1 signal Setting-up selected. BI: p2653 = 0 signal Positioning selected.

descriere_scurta: EPOS direct setpoint input/MDI mode adaptation
descriere: Sets the signal source to interconnect the MDI mode to the operating mode "direct setpoint input MDI" via PROFIBUS telegram 110. CI: p2654 = 0 The binector inputs listed below are evaluated. CI: p2654 > 0 The following binector inputs are not evaluated: - BI: p2648 (positioning type) - BI: p2651 (direction selection, positive) - BI: p2652 (direction selection, negative) In this case, the following definitions apply: Signal via CI: p2654 = xx0x hex -> absolute Signal via CI: p2654 = xx1x hex -> relative Signal via CI: p2654 = xx2x hex -> abs_pos (only for modulo correction) Signal via CI: p2654 = xx3x hex -> abs_neg (only for modulo correction)
Sets the signal source to enable the basic positioner. BI: p2656 = 1 signal The basic positioner is enabled. BI: p2656 = 0 signal The basic positioner is not enabled.

descriere_scurta: EPOS position actual value/position setting value
descriere: Sets the signal source for the position actual value/position setting value.

descriere_scurta: EPOS pos. actual value valid feedback signal
descriere: Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "position actual value is valid". BI: p2658 = 1 signal The position actual value received via CI: p2657 is valid. BI: p2658 = 0 signal The position actual value received via CI: p2657 is invalid.
Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "referencing active". BI: p2659 = 1 signal Referencing is active. BI: p2659 = 0 signal Referencing is not active.
Sets the signal source for the measured value for the function "referencing".

descriere_scurta: EPOS measured value valid feedback signal
descriere: Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "measured value valid". BI: p2661 = 1 signal The measured value received via CI: p2660 is valid. BI: p2661 = 0 signal The measured value received via CI: p2660 is invalid.

descriere_scurta: EPOS adjustment value valid feedback signal
descriere: Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "adjustment value valid". BI: p2662 = 1 signal The adjustment value received via CI: p2660 is valid. BI: p2662 = 0 signal The adjustment value received via CI: p2660 is not valid.
Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "clamping active for travel to fixed stop". BI: p2663 = 1 signal Clamping is active BI: p2663 = 0 signal Clamping is not active.
Sets a fixed setpoint for the position.
Sets a fixed setpoint for the velocity.
Sets a fixed setpoint for the acceleration override.
Sets a fixed setpoint for the deceleration override.
Setting and connector output for a fixed percentage value.
Setting and connector output for a fixed percentage value.
Torque constant for the synchronous motor determined by the motor data identification. This torque constant can be changed after the identification and accepted in p0316 with p1910/p1960 = -3.

Voltage constant for a synchronous motor determined by the motor data identification. This voltage constant can be changed after the identification and accepted in p0317 with p1910/p1960 = -3. Units for rotating synchronous motors: Vrms/(1000 rpm), phase-to-phase
Magnetizing current for an induction motor determined by the motor data identification. This magnetizing current can be changed after the identification and accepted in p0320 with p1910/p1960 = -3.
Optimum load angle for a synchronous motor determined by the motor data identification. This optimum load angle can be changed after the identification and accepted in p0327 with p1910/p1960 = -3.

Reluctance torque constant for a synchronous motor determined by the motor data identification. This reluctance torque constant can be changed after the identification and accepted in p0328 with p1910/p1960 = - 3.
Sets the factor for the plane compensation in the positive direction from the characteristic identification. This value corresponds to p1830 of the drive data set selected for the identification.
Sets the factor for the plane compensation in the negative direction from the characteristic identification. This value corresponds to p1831 of the drive data set selected for the identification.

descriere_scurta: ChId transition point compensation Q1 positive zero range
descriere: Displays the flow rate Q for point 1 positive (zero range) of the transition point compensation from the characteristic identification. This value corresponds to p1833 of the drive data set selected for the identification.
